plugins.name: tte-builder
plugins.description: Guides researchers through specifying a target trial and its emulation for pharmacoepidemiology and comparative-effectiveness studies, with a time-zero gate, PubMed-verified references, and explicit uncertainty tagging. Hands off the adjustment set to the dag-builder skill.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Git and GitHub for group projects in R and RStudio: sets up a project's repository with a considered .gitignore, then runs the everyday loop of pull, commit, guarded push, branch, pull request and conflict resolution. Ships an enforced guard against force-pushes and other commands that destroy work git cannot recover.
